theorem_contract.input: Two positive child short metrics on one retained common fiber.
theorem_contract.exact_output: One scale-free Hermitian Cayley contraction and a branch-gauge-equivalent Naimark column.
theorem_contract.recursive_contract: Every output branch gauge is used as the corresponding child input-coordinate gauge.
theorem_contract.root_contract: The remaining root gauge is included in the physical common-fiber coordinate embedding.
theorem_contract.compiler_premise: Normalization-one coherent block encoding of D and retained endpoint gap delta.
theorem_contract.excluded_claims: No construction of the natural D oracle, all-depth mass theorem, decoder, separation, or speedup.

theorem.canonical_contraction: D=M^-1/2(E_L-E_R)M^-1/2 is a Hermitian contraction and K_L=(I+D)/2, K_R=(I-D)/2.
theorem.branch_effect_identity: The canonical positive-root endpoint and N_D=[sqrt(K_L);sqrt(K_R)] induce exactly the same binary effects.
theorem.graph_transfer_relation: In graph coordinates D_T=(I-T*T)(I+T*T)^-1 and D_T is unitarily similar to the canonical D through the graph input gauge.
theorem.scale_cancellation: E_s -> c E_s leaves D, its binary effects, and N_D unchanged.
theorem.recursive_gauge_covariance: Matched child-coordinate gauges telescope on every root-to-leaf path and leave all leaf POVM effects invariant.
theorem.root_anchor_boundary: An unmatched root input gauge conjugates the POVM; it must be included in the physical root coordinate embedding.
theorem.conditional_compiler: A normalization-one block encoding of D with endpoint gap delta conditionally gives a polynomial QSVT Naimark compiler without T polar access.
theorem.surviving_target: Construct the actual affine-node normalized short-grading D directly from Schur/Racah structure, with root anchor and all-depth native mass.
theorem.scope: Exact local algebra and recursive gauge theorem only; no natural all-n D oracle, physical PGM, decoder, classical separation, or speedup.

proof_obligations.resolution: Equation (1) is exactly the signed binary effect and is Hermitian with norm below one.
Matched node gauges telescope algebraically on every path; all leaf effects are unchanged.
The adversarial root control changes a branch effect by a constant when the root gauge is omitted.
Normalized affine frame LCUs do not yet implement the normalized shorted grading.
Only finite controls and the existing final-root weak-law trim are available.

adversarial_audit.objection: The graph Cayley matrix can be used in any parent basis.
adversarial_audit.resolution: False: it is only unitarily similar to the canonical Cayley matrix, and an unanchored root similarity changes the POVM.

adversarial_audit.objection: Noncommuting short metrics invalidate the branch-root Naimark form.
adversarial_audit.resolution: False: noncommutativity moves into child-side polar gauges; the branch effects remain exact functions of D.

adversarial_audit.objection: A common exponentially small short scale forces Cayley inversion cost.
adversarial_audit.resolution: The exact target cancels that scale, including controls through 2^-48; access to the normalized target remains separate and open.

adversarial_audit.objection: The conditional D compiler is already a natural affine PGM circuit.
adversarial_audit.resolution: No representation-specific normalized D block encoding or all-depth retained-mass recurrence is supplied.

claim_gate.reason: The preferred local target is now a scale-free Hermitian contraction with exact recursive child-gauge covariance, but the actual affine Schur/Racah oracle for that contraction and the root coordinate anchor have not been compiled.

summary: Replaced the non-Hermitian relative transfer as the preferred binary compiler target by the scale-free Hermitian Cayley contraction. Its QSVT Naimark column has exactly the canonical branch effects, differs only by child gauges that telescope recursively, and exposes one honest remaining boundary: a normalized affine Schur/Racah oracle plus root anchor.
falsifiers_triggered: Recovering the polar part of T is unnecessary for the local two-outcome POVM once canonical D is available.
Internal child-coordinate gauges do not accumulate into a recursive error when propagated covariantly.
An unanchored root input gauge is not harmless and can change a branch effect by constant operator norm.
Scale cancellation in the mathematical Cayley target does not itself construct its coherent representation oracle.
